scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:all
scripts.build:all: npm run --workspace=@workspace/api-server build && npm run --workspace=@workspace/quantstock build && npm run --workspace=@workspace/mockup-sandbox build
scripts.reinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['node_modules','package-lock.json','.package-lock.json'])fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});" && npm cache clean --force && npm i
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck:all
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run --workspace=@workspace/api-server typecheck && npm run --workspace=@workspace/quantstock typecheck && npm run --workspace=@workspace/mockup-sandbox typecheck
